totals.gpu_note: peak GPU memory is a per-process counter; the evaluation ran in a separate process that has already exited, so no honest per-phase value can be reported. Training-phase peaks remain in each result.json budget block.
totals.rss_note: process RSS is likewise NOT_MEASURED for the evaluation process
totals.batch_note: implied_batches_256 = ceil(n_rows/256) arithmetic only; the implementation batches internally and was not instrumented, so no measured encoder-batch count is claimed
totals.archive_note: archive_bytes is the sum of every artifact kept for a record (all task heads, all state packages, all boundary npz, the test npz). It is NOT the algorithmic resident state; the resident column is model + final head + final state package.
totals.budget_match_note: R1/R2 perform zero training and reuse the S1 encoder; LN/POOL/C1/C2 train Task1 under the shared encoder budget. Budgets are therefore not matched, so all candidate-vs-S1 and R2-vs-R1 statements are PERFORMANCE CONTRASTS, not equal-budget efficiency claims.
